kind: Offline characterization, not product acceptance or a real database race test

environment.dependency_environment: Existing chat_offline_followup_20261008 locked-deps; no old mixed-Zod dependency environment
environment.network: deny-network.mjs blocks global fetch and net.Socket.connect

tests.typecheck: Passed for the new test and imported dependency graph; full-repository checks not run
tests.batch_stop_policy: Sequential retained then revoked; log and exit status saved; stop immediately on first failure
tests.expected_current_baseline: The tests deliberately assert absent document reporting in the retained case, recording the reporting gap without weakening cancellation or authority guards.

reporting_gap: After the synthetic commit marker and external cancellation, an authorized caller receives/persists stopped/cancelled with empty text and tools; the original-message retry returns that original empty result without another runtime or write. This does not establish a lost-write defect.

future_acceptance_difference.still_current_authorized_scope: A separate authorized read of the original durable ledger should expose only a minimal committed receipt/reference and distinguish saved effect from unfinished text, without re-execution. Current baseline does not do this.
future_acceptance_difference.revoked_or_changed_identity_scope_epoch_: No stale body, reference or unauthorized receipt may be exposed; current revoked fixture passes this boundary.
future_acceptance_difference.runtime_guard: The runtime tools=[] cancellation/authority guard must remain intact.

root_reviewed_interface_direction.proposed_read_only_port: ProductAgentStore.documentReceipts(scope, runId), naming subject to root decision
root_reviewed_interface_direction.required_guard: Revalidate current identity, user/child/workspace scope, authorization version, storage epoch, original source message and committed ledger record before projection. No receipt from an uncommitted attempt.
root_reviewed_interface_direction.durability: Persist minimal run-to-operation association atomically in the existing writeDocument document transaction. Existing family_document_operations has no run relation; process-local handles alone are insufficient.
root_reviewed_interface_direction.existing_reusable_constraint: agent_runs_action_scope UNIQUE(id,child_id,owner_user_id) can anchor a scoped relationship. Existing agent_action_calls cannot be repurposed because its FK requires an agent_action_receipts row.

evidence_symbols.symbol: persisted receipt reconstruction and stopped text
stopped result generic message projection (static only)

unrun: Other three product Agent implementations or tests
mutations: Only one new test file and this evidence artifact. No product, runtime, prompt, budget or migration changes. No push, PR, merge or deployment.
